theme: Light, neutral professional (clean whites/slates, print-shop precision feel)
design_principles: Precision Prepress Aesthetic: Professional print-shop tool, NOT a generic AI prompt box or neon consumer app
Data & Metric Clarity: High contrast typography for resolution metrics, effective PPI, target enlarged pixels, and scale factors
Generous Spacing & High Intention: Air around cards, clear 1px subtle borders, zero clutter, responsive grid layouts
Tactile Micro-Feedback: Subtle border glows on active print mode selection, smooth progress steps, clear before/after slider
forbidden_elements: Neon AI styling, glowing magenta/purple gradients (#7351B7), and dark cyberpunk void aesthetics
Chatbot interfaces, prompt textboxes, or vague AI magic sparkle overload
Cartoon graphics or low-contrast text on transparent backgrounds
Missing data-testid attributes on interactive elements

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 leading-tight
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-slate-900

layout_and_grid.card_style: bg-white border border-slate-200 rounded-xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200 p-6 sm:p-8
layout_and_grid.active_card_style: bg-white border-2 border-sky-600 rounded-xl shadow-md p-6 sm:p-8

workflow_steps.title: Upload
workflow_steps.description: Upload high-res photo, digital vector, or AI output
key_elements: File metadata card (Dimensions in px, Megapixels MP, File size MB, Format)
Image thumbnail preview with zoom thumbnail

workflow_steps.title: Print Setup
workflow_steps.description: Select print medium, custom size, and viewing distance
key_elements: Print Type selector cards (Billboard, Banner, Poster, Sign, Trade Show Display, Custom)
Dimension input form (Width, Height) with Unit Toggle (Inches, Feet, cm, mm)
Viewing Distance selector (<3 ft Close, 3-10 ft Medium, >10 ft Far/Billboard)

workflow_steps.title: Resolution Analysis
workflow_steps.description: Preflight resolution check and target PPI calculation
key_elements: Source Quality Badge (Excellent, Good, Needs Enhancement, Low Resolution)
Current Effective PPI vs Recommended PPI gauge
Magnification & Scale Factor display (e.g., 4.5x enlargement required)

workflow_steps.title: Enhance
workflow_steps.description: Select enhancement mode and process image
key_elements: Enhancement mode cards: 'Print Accurate' (sharp lines, anti-halo) vs 'AI Artwork' (synthesized detail, grain control)
Processing progress screen with 5 multi-stage status indicators (Pre-flight, Spatial grid, Frequency separation, Edge sharpening, Color profile verification)

workflow_steps.title: Download
workflow_steps.description: Compare before/after and download print-ready master file
key_elements: Interactive before/after comparison slider with split view handle
Zoom controls (Fit, 100% Crop View, 200% Pixel Detail)
Print Readiness Audit Card (Bleed status, PPI target check, Color profile CMYK/RGB advisory)
Download options (300 DPI PDF, Uncompressed TIFF, Ultra PNG)

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the 5-step progress workflow for main application state (Upload -> Print Setup -> Analyze -> Enhance -> Download).
Build a responsive header with navigation links (How it Works, Use Cases, Resolution Guide), CTA button, and clean branding.
Implement Landing Page sections when not in active workflow mode: Hero section with clear headline, 3-step value prop, supported use-cases cards, sample before/after demonstration, and Prepress FAQ.
Use clean, professional UI with subtle slates, crisp white cards, and sky-blue accent colors. DO NOT use dark cyberpunk or purple gradient themes.
Ensure every interactive element has explicit data-testid attributes for testing automation.
Use lucide-react icons for UI elements (Upload, Check, AlertTriangle, Layers, Maximize, ZoomIn, Download, Sliders, Info, Printer).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Follow light neutral prepress studio guidelines. Include data-testid on all interactive buttons, steps, inputs, and badges. Avoid neon AI slop, transparent dropdown backgrounds, or transition:all.
